title: Bias-constrained multimodal intelligence for equitable and reliable clinical AI

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance metrics (such as accuracy, Dice score, BLEU, and ROUGE) across diverse medical imaging modalities (e.g., CT, MRI, ultrasound, dermoscopy) to ensure robust performance on both common and rare imaging techniques.

Evaluating multi-class and multi-label classification accuracy on long-tailed datasets (e.g., ISIC2018, CXR-LT2024) by dividing classes into head (many), medium, and tail (few) subgroups based on sample counts.
Assessing image segmentation performance (Dice and IoU scores) on anatomical regions and lesions stratified by their occurrence prevalence (head, medium, tail) in the training data.
Comparing macro-averaged accuracy of multi-label chest disease classification between female and male patient subgroups.
Comparing macro-averaged accuracy of multi-label chest disease classification across Asian, Black, and White patient subgroups.
Comparing macro-averaged accuracy of multi-label chest disease classification across multiple age cohorts (0-40, 40-60, 60-80, and 80+ years).
